bar0_health._note: Device-health proxy readable via HAILBRÚ: BAR0+0x018C host-interrupt status (H087). Threshold semantics: nonzero sticky bits across 3 consecutive samples emit a HealthAnomaly event (see vordr/monitor.mojo policy).

device_die._note: UNAVAILABLE — the Hailo-10 die temperature is NOT readable on the current kernel (no documented register; H087). Pi SoC temperature is the host proxy, NOT the device temperature. No fabricated device-die thresholds.
